payload.leagueSummary: NET is still a dogfight at the top, with KeithK75, Dan94, and MattF basically taking turns acting like they own the place. Underneath that, the window is split between dudes who can absolutely rip the ball tee to green and dudes who are surviving on one hot unit—usually putting, short game, or both—because this league loves a messy follow-through. The gross side is even more brutal: the best ball-strikers keep poking through, while the rest of the field is busy donating strokes like it’s a charity scramble with no charity.
leagueBullets: KeithK75 and Dan94 are the cleanest overall profiles: both are living in the upper lane of the ball-striking table, and they’re not doing it with one cute skill hiding the leaks.
MattF is the classic ‘everything works until it doesn’t’ problem for everyone else—good enough everywhere to stay dangerous, and the putter keeps the whole contraption from exploding.
There’s a big split between volatile rescue acts and straight-up leaks: tnboles77 can save rounds with the short game, while Leroy4522 and DREADFUL are bleeding shots before the chips even matter.
